story.start: SENTINEL OFFLINE. SENTINEL is the AI security system of NOVA Technologies. Noor, the Cybersecurity Engineer on Project ORION, was using it in her investigation before she disappeared. Someone sabotaged it. Repair its three systems and it will release what it recorded.
story.passed: SENTINEL RESTORED. All systems are back online. Recovered record:
story.failed: SENTINEL UNSTABLE. Some systems could not be restored. Your team did not reach the required score.

missions.title: PREDICT
missions.intro: SENTINEL's prediction engine was corrupted. Noor, NOVA's Cybersecurity Engineer, tracked a white van through it. Retrain the engine before it misleads anyone else.

stages.title: Outlier Hunt
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: "The van's GPS jumps around. Some pings are real, some are noise. Find the noise without throwing away good data." Method: east and north are judged separately, and a ping is flagged if it is outside on either one. IQR uses Tukey's hinges (the medians of the lower and upper halves) with fences at Q1 - k x IQR and Q3 + k x IQR. Z-score uses the population standard deviation (divide by n).
stages.brief: These are the white van's GPS pings (km east and north of the NOVA campus gate). Choose a detector, IQR or Z-score, with a threshold, then run it to see which pings it flags. Try as many settings as you like, then submit the one you trust.

stages.title: Feature Check
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Careful what you teach it. A column can give the answer away, or it can be only a label that tells the model nothing.
stages.brief: SENTINEL predicts which gate a vehicle will leave by (the target: Exit gate). For each column, decide whether to use it as an input or drop it. Think about what is known at the moment of the prediction, and what is only an identifier.

stages.title: Neuron Check
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Multiply each input by its weight, add the results and the bias. ReLU keeps a positive number as it is and turns any negative number into 0.
stages.brief:
A neuron in SENTINEL scores a card swipe.
Inputs: x1 = 3 (hours after closing), x2 = 2 (failed logins)
Weights: w1 = 0.5, w2 = -2. Bias: b = 1.
The neuron computes z = w1·x1 + w2·x2 + b, then outputs ReLU(z) = max(0, z).
What does the neuron output?

missions.title: SEE
missions.intro: Noor connected SENTINEL's cameras to the gates of the NOVA campus. The sabotage left them half blind. Check what they see and how well they see it.

stages.title: Nearest Vehicle
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: The nearest neighbours of the unknown vehicle are the labelled vehicles closest to it. With k = 1 one vehicle decides; with a larger k the k nearest vote and the majority class wins. Think about how much one odd vehicle can sway each vote.
stages.brief: The cameras measured an unknown vehicle (the hollow diamond) by its length and height. Use the k control to see which labelled vehicles are its k nearest neighbours and how they vote. Answer: its class when k = 1, its class when k = 5, and which of the two settings you trust more.

stages.title: Camera Accuracy
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Count the four groups first: true positives, false positives, false negatives and true negatives. Precision asks: of the frames the camera flagged, how many were real? Recall asks: of the real ones, how many did the camera flag?
stages.brief: Twenty camera frames: whether a white van was really there, and what the camera said. Fill in the four counts, then precision and recall as decimals (0.80, not 80%). Finally choose the metric that matters most when the goal is not to miss the van.

stages.title: Patrol Evolution
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Crossover joins the start of one parent to the end of the other. A mutation flips one bit: 0 becomes 1 and 1 becomes 0. Do the crossover first, then the mutation.
stages.brief:
SENTINEL searches for the best patrol route with a genetic algorithm. Each route is written as bits:
    Parent A:  1 0 1 | 1 0 0
    Parent B:  0 1 1 | 0 1 1
1. Crossover after position 3: the child takes the first 3 bits from Parent A and the rest from Parent B.
2. Mutation: flip bit number 5 (counting from the left, starting at 1).
What is the final child?

missions.title: ECHO
missions.intro: ECHO is NOVA's assistant: it plans, decides and answers from company records. Noor relied on it in her investigation. Bring it back online.

stages.title: Route Planner
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: A* ranks the places on the frontier by f = g + h, where g is the cost of the road so far and h is the estimate of the cost still to go. Always expand the frontier place with the lowest f.
stages.brief: Plan SENTINEL's patrol route from Library to Gate 3 with A*. Each road shows its cost and each place its estimate h of the cost still to go. Click the next place to expand from the frontier: it must have the lowest f = g + h. Then give the order in which you expanded places (ending at Gate 3), the route, and its total cost.
stages.tieBreak: If two places have the same f, expand the one that comes first alphabetically.

stages.title: Best Split
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Find the entropy of each child group first. Weight each one by the share of swipes it holds, add them, and subtract from the parent's entropy. The gain is how much uncertainty the split removes.
stages.brief:
A node holds 8 card swipes: 4 normal and 4 suspicious, so its entropy is 1.
SENTINEL splits it on "After closing time?":
    Yes: 1 normal, 3 suspicious
    No:  3 normal, 1 suspicious
Entropy = -Σ p·log2(p). Information gain = entropy of the parent - weighted average entropy of the children.
Useful: log2(0.25) = -2, log2(0.75) ≈ -0.415.
What is the information gain, approximately?

stages.title: Patrol Game
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: Start at the bottom. Each MIN node keeps its smallest value, because the intruder plays against you. Then MAX picks the largest of those.
stages.brief:
A security drone (MAX) picks a route; the intruder (MIN) then answers with the move that is worst for the drone. Values are for the drone.
    MAX
    ├─ MIN: 3, 5
    ├─ MIN: 2, 9
    └─ MIN: 4, 6
What value can the drone guarantee with minimax?

stages.title: RAG Fix
stages.fieldNote: Noor's notes: "ECHO answers from what it retrieves. Feed it the right pages."
stages.brief: Ask ECHO where Noor was last confirmed. Choose a chunk size (how much text each retrieved piece holds) and a top-k (how many pieces ECHO reads), then press Ask ECHO to see what it retrieves and how it answers. You may try 3 different settings. Then lock the one you want ECHO to use.
